title: Weights multiply under tensor product
statement: Fix primes $p$ and $\ell\ne p$, an integer $a\ge1$, and $q=p^a>1$. Choose an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a field isomorphism $\iota:\Qlb\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf C$, as in [def-weil-frobenius-module-weights]. For a scalar $\gamma\in\Qlb$, having $\iota$-weight $w\in\mathbf R$ means $|\iota(\gamma)|=q^{w/2}$, using the complex absolute value [def-weil-complex-absolute-value] and positive real powers [def-weil-real-power]. If $\alpha,\beta\in\Qlb$ have $\iota$-weights $w_1,w_2$, then $\alpha\beta$ has $\iota$-weight $w_1+w_2$, and $\alpha^{-1}$ has $\iota$-weight $-w_1$ when $\alpha\ne0$. In particular this applies to nonzero Frobenius eigenvalues with those weights.

proof.text:
The field isomorphism preserves products, and the complex absolute value is multiplicative by [def-weil-complex-absolute-value]. Since $q>1$, the addition law for positive real powers in [def-weil-real-power] applies. Substituting the two hypotheses gives
$$|\iota(\alpha\beta)|=|\iota(\alpha)\iota(\beta)|=|\iota(\alpha)|\,|\iota(\beta)|=q^{w_1/2}q^{w_2/2}=q^{w_1/2+w_2/2}=q^{(w_1+w_2)/2}.$$
This is exactly the stated scalar weight condition for the product.

Suppose $\alpha\ne0$. Since $\iota$ preserves inverses, multiplicativity in [def-weil-complex-absolute-value] gives $|\iota(\alpha^{-1})|\,|\iota(\alpha)|=|1|=1$. The given value $|\iota(\alpha)|=q^{w_1/2}$ is positive by [def-weil-real-power]. Its reciprocal is $q^{-w_1/2}$: the power addition law gives $q^{w_1/2}q^{-w_1/2}=q^0=1$, where $q^0=\exp(0)=1$ by that definition. Dividing the first equality by the positive number $q^{w_1/2}$ therefore yields $|\iota(\alpha^{-1})|=q^{-w_1/2}=q^{(-w_1)/2}$, which is weight $-w_1$.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q89-9595de9fc (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the master and main-20261015 sources for lem-tw-multiplicativity, def-tw-eigenvalue, the unit sk-r-real-linear (_section.md and proof), the three cited nodes in full, and both DAG citers. The repaired statement uses |iota(gamma)|=q^{w/2} with w real, which is the convention of the unit, of def-weil-frobenius-module-weights and of both citers (lem-tw-dual-negation and lem-tw-tate-twist-weight-shift with q_y=q^m). This does not weaken the item: integer weights become real weights, eigenvalues become arbitrary scalars, and both the product and the inverse clauses are kept. The change is named under the Source error heading. Steps 1 and 2 are elementary and use only what the statements of def-weil-complex-absolute-value (|zw|=|z||w|, |1|=1) and def-weil-real-power (positivity, x^{y1+y2}=x^{y1}x^{y2}, x^y=exp(y log x)) actually say. I checked the cases weights 0, q (weight 2), q^{-1}, roots of unity, a non-integral weight, alpha=0 (excluded because q^{w/2}>0), and the tate-twist shift. There are no new nodes and no duplicate in the DAG. No route departure, cycle or SGA use, and no tool_uses.
